create_task.name: create_task
create_task.description: Creates a new task in Fragment.

url.description: A URL associated with the task (e.g., link to a ticket or resource)

assignee.description: Email of the person to assign this task to.

custom_fields.description: Additional custom fields for the task

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new task in Fragment with a title and optional URL, due date, assignee email, tags, and custom fields. Use to add a work item to a Fragment queue. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate task even with identical input.

task_uid.description: The unique identifier of the task to update

title.description: The updated title of the task

url.description: The updated URL for the task

assignee.description: Email of the person to assign this task to

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Fragment task identified by its task UID, changing any of title, URL, due date, status (TODO/STARTED/DONE), assignee email, tags, or custom fields. Only the fields you supply are modified. Idempotent: re-applying the same field values to the same task yields the same end state.

get_task.name: get_task
get_task.description: Retrieves details of a specific task.

task_uid.description: The unique identifier of the task to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single Fragment task by its unique task UID. Use when you already have a task identifier and need its current data. Read-only and idempotent.

list_tasks.name: list_tasks
list_tasks.description: Retrieves a list of tasks from.

assignee.description: Filter tasks by assignee email or ID

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (default: 50)

aiMetadata.description: Lists tasks from Fragment, optionally filtered by status (TODO/STARTED/DONE) and assignee, and capped by a limit (default 50). Omit the filters to return recent tasks across all statuses. Use to discover task UIDs or survey tasks before acting on them. Read-only and idempotent.

task_uid.description: The unique identifier of the task to delete

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a Fragment task identified by its unique task UID. Use to remove a task; this is destructive and cannot be undone. Effectively idempotent: re-deleting an already-removed task has no further effect, though the API may return a not-found error.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to any Fragment endpoint

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to [Developer Settings](https://app.onfragment.com/settings/account/developers).

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: You can obtain your API token by navigating to [Developer Settings](https://app.onfragment.com/settings/account/developers).

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

new_task.name: new_task
new_task.description: Triggers when a new task is created.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new task is created in Fragment, emitting the newly created task. Polls for tasks ordered by creation time, so each run yields tasks added since the last check.

task_updated.name: task_updated
task_updated.description: Triggers when a task is updated.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when an existing Fragment task is modified, emitting the updated task. Polls for tasks ordered by update time, so each run yields tasks changed since the last check; it also fires for newly created tasks since creation counts as an update.
